text.card: A red giant 10,603 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 2.60 solar masses and 22.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,831 K at its surface.
